Initial release of Image to Video Editor AI — convert images into animated videos.

- Convert JPG, PNG, WEBP, and HEIC images (up to 200MB) into 1080p MP4 video clips.
- Fast, cloud-based processing (typically 30–60 seconds per video).
- Seamless workflow: drag and drop images, specify edits or effects, and export videos.
- Includes session handling, free credit management, and automatic error handling for common cases.
- Designed for social media creators seeking quick, shareable video edits from static images.
